evidence.claim: Curtis Instruments produce controller per la velocità dei motori e strumentazione, con sede a Mount Kisco e stabilimenti a Porto Rico, Bulgaria e Cina.
evidence.quote: With headquarters in Mount Kisco, New York, and four state-of-the-art design engineering centers worldwide, Curtis manufactures motor speed controllers and instrumentation, ensuring top quality and performance for a wide range of industries. || Curtis Manufacturing produces all products in-house across manufacturing sites in Puerto Rico, Bulgaria, and China to meet global demand.
